This figure is a combination chart that displays the training set size (训练集数量, blue bars), validation set size (验证集数量, orange bars), and accuracy (准确率, gray line) across five task categories. The horizontal axis contains five categorical labels: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition). The left vertical axis represents the dataset size with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200, with gridlines at intervals of 200. The right vertical axis represents accuracy on a scale from 0 to 1.0, with intervals of 0.1. For each category, a blue bar indicates the training set size and an orange bar indicates the validation set size, with the blue bar positioned to the left and the orange bar to the right within each group. The training set sizes are 1102 for 实体识别, 1095 for 角色识别, 1077 for 异常识别, 1210 for 空间推理, and 5 for 同义识别. The validation set sizes are 250 for 实体识别, 190 for 角色识别, 40 for 异常识别, 675 for 空间推理, and 55 for 同义识别. The gray line with data point labels shows accuracy values of 0.7666 for 实体识别, 0.8714 for 角色识别, 0.692 for 异常识别, 0.2852 for 空间推理, and 0.3769 for 同义识别. The blue bars are relatively tall and similar in height for the first four categories, with 空间推理 being the tallest at 1210, while 同义识别 has a notably small blue bar at only 5. The orange bars vary considerably, with 空间推理 having the largest validation set at 675 and 异常识别 the smallest at 40. The accuracy line rises from 实体识别 to 角色识别, then declines sharply through 异常识别 and 空间推理, before slightly recovering at 同义识别. The bars do not appear to follow a specific sorted order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color coding described in the legend.
